subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt/rebase the open fork PR at https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/149, or supersede it and allow a fresh narrow fix for this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open conflicting PR with closing syntax already exists, so automation should not create a duplicate implementation until maintainers pick the landing path.

options.title: Supersede the fork path
options.body: Close or mark the fork PR as superseded, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page structure with localized copy and proof.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch, move the change to the current files, add tests/proof, and review it as the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Supersede the fork path
recommendation.body: Close or mark the fork PR as superseded, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Debug page structure with localized copy and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest historical ownership signal for the Debug surface and is a good routing owner for deciding whether to adopt or supersede the fork path.
